mapper.select: select m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_type, m.name, m.path, m.component, m.title, m.icon, m.sort, m.is_hide, m.is_hide_tab, m.keep_alive, m.is_full_page, m.is_first_level, m.fixed_tab, m.link, m.is_iframe, m.active_path, m.auth_mark from blog_menu m where m.deleted_at = 0 and m.is_enabled = 1 and ( -- 角色关联的菜单 m.id in ( select rm.menu_id from blog_role_menu rm inner join blog_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id and ur.deleted_at = 0 inner join blog_role r on rm.role_id = r.id and r.deleted_at = 0 and r.is_enabled = 1 where rm.deleted_at = 0 and ur.user_id = #{userId} ) -- 额外授予的菜单 or m.id in ( select um.menu_id from blog_user_menu um where um.deleted_at = 0 and um.user_id = #{userId} and um.type = 1 ) ) -- 排除额外移除的菜单 and m.id not in ( select um.menu_id from blog_user_menu um where um.deleted_at = 0 and um.user_id = #{userId} and um.type = 2 ) order by m.sort, m.id

select m.id from blog_menu m where m.deleted_at = 0 and m.is_enabled = 1 and ( m.id in ( select rm.menu_id from blog_role_menu rm inner join blog_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id and ur.deleted_at = 0 inner join blog_role r on rm.role_id = r.id and r.deleted_at = 0 and r.is_enabled = 1 where rm.deleted_at = 0 and ur.user_id = #{userId} ) or m.id in ( select um.menu_id from blog_user_menu um where um.deleted_at = 0 and um.user_id = #{userId} and um.type = 1 ) ) and m.id not in ( select um.menu_id from blog_user_menu um where um.deleted_at = 0 and um.user_id = #{userId} and um.type = 2 )
select m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.title from blog_menu m where m.deleted_at = 0 and m.is_enabled = 1 order by m.sort, m.id
select m.path from blog_menu m where m.deleted_at = 0 and m.is_enabled = 1 and m.menu_type = 3 and m.path is not null and m.path != ''
mapper.insert: insert into blog_menu (parent_id, menu_type, name, path, component, title, icon, sort, is_hide, is_hide_tab, keep_alive, is_full_page, is_first_level, fixed_tab, link, is_iframe, active_path, auth_mark, is_enabled, deleted_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{parentId}, #{menuType}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{component, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title}, #{icon, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sort}, #{isHide}, #{isHideTab}, #{keepAlive}, #{isFullPage}, #{isFirstLevel}, #{fixedTab}, #{link, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isIframe}, #{activePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{authMark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isEnabled}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: select id, parent_id as parentId, menu_type as menuType from blog_menu where deleted_at = 0 and id = #{id}

select id, parent_id as parentId, menu_type as menuType, name, path, component, title, icon, sort, is_hide as isHide, is_hide_tab as isHideTab, keep_alive as keepAlive, is_full_page as isFullPage, is_first_level as isFirstLevel, fixed_tab as fixedTab, link, is_iframe as isIframe, active_path as activePath, auth_mark as authMark, is_enabled as isEnabled from blog_menu where deleted_at = 0 and id = #{id}
mapper.update: update blog_menu set parent_id = #{parentId}, name = #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, path = #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, component = #{component, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, title = #{title}, icon = #{icon, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sort = #{sort}, is_hide = #{isHide}, is_hide_tab = #{isHideTab}, keep_alive = #{keepAlive}, is_full_page = #{isFullPage}, fixed_tab = #{fixedTab}, link = #{link, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_iframe = #{isIframe}, active_path = #{activePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, auth_mark = #{authMark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_enabled = #{isEnabled}, update_time = NOW() where deleted_at = 0 and id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from blog_menu where deleted_at = 0 and parent_id = #{parentId}
